data.analysis_policy: The defined crystal-content estimate uses intact protein mass excluding solvent: assume one canonical unmodified linear chain A with free termini per asymmetric unit, and the stated4 symmetry copies in the orthorhombic unit cell. Use average molecular mass, not monoisotopic mass or a digest. Vm=unit-cell volume/(number of protein copies*single-chain mass), in A3/Da. Approximate solvent fraction=1-1.23/Vm, with1.23 A3/Da as the declared conventional protein partial-volume approximation. Also obtain the uploaded PDB's as-parsed atomic inventory mass, including every parsed topology atom; do not add hydrogens, strip waters or occupancy-weight that separate inventory calculation. Signed error means solvent fraction computed using inventory mass minus the defined intact-protein-based fraction. This is a reporting-basis audit; no claim that atom-inventory mass equals intact sequence mass or that this approximate fraction measures a solvent-channel geometry.

source_provenance.export_transformation: Original complete ATOM/HETATM coordinates and CRYST1 retained. Only two REMARK280 lines reporting precomputed solvent/Matthews summaries were omitted to prevent answer copying; the deposited raw snapshot is preserved separately. This metadata projection is not a new experiment or a modified protein structure.
source_provenance.calculation_convention: Free-terminus, unmodified canonical sequence average mass is an explicitly declared calculation convention, not an independent assay of every chemical state.

provenance.kind: Public historical records and/or explicitly disclosed derived audit inputs; source-specific provenance is in the study record. Controlled numerical teaching fixtures make no experimental observation claim.
